notMeasured: Hosting, WAF, shared quota or production security
method: One held-out fictional dataset through the actual upload pipeline: bounded parser, Claude classification, Claude extraction with JSON-schema structured output, deterministic grounding and application comparison, then the browser case functions over recorded results. Expected answers withheld from both models. The runner injects a no-op quota; no hosting or firewall claims. Every model failure and extra field is retained. Ready for review never means accepted.
